title: Hello from Barcelona
text:
Hi Tom,

I'm in Barcelona with my friend Kasia. It's great! The city is big and beautiful, and it is very hot – 32 degrees today! Our hotel is next to the beach, so we swim in the sea every day. Yesterday we visited a famous church, the Sagrada Família. It is very tall and very old. The food here is good, but it is expensive. I buy fruit in the market every morning. On Thursday we fly back to Poland.

Bye for now,
Marek
